candidates.title: School student and book-loan records

demandEvidence.chore: Register students and books in a school lending system.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Du registrerar elever och böcker i vårt utlåningssystem

ease.reason: A mock register can use fictional student and book rows; the notice names registration but no required fields.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a school might value faster record entry; this paid vacancy does not show demand for an AI service.

feasibility.reason: A two-week fictional-data prototype can validate required fields, but cannot safely connect to a real school system.

autonomy.reason: A prototype could check and prepare entries; staff must verify records and enter them into the official system.

evidence.reason: The fresh paid notice explicitly names student and book registration, but gives no fields, frequency, or system constraints.

candidates.reason: Considered because the notice identifies a concrete record-entry chore. Reject below the unrounded threshold: the safe mock workflow is plausible, but key fields and school-system constraints are absent, and AI-service demand is unproved.

rejected.title: School student and book-loan records
rejected.reason: Below the unrounded publish threshold: although the notice names registering students and books, it gives no required fields or exception rules; a proposal can only be a fictional-data mock, and AI-service demand is unproved.

rejected.title: School administrator and family support
rejected.reason: Reject: the fresh notice describes a broad school-administrator role and relationships with families, but identifies no concrete repeatable task to scope without inventing duties.

rejected.title: School administration and service support
rejected.reason: Reject: the notice says the administrator supports students, principals, teachers, and staff but gives no specific task steps, inputs, or constraints for a bounded experiment.

rejected.title: School staff and student administration
rejected.reason: Reject: the notice names staff and student administration and general practical or administrative duties, but supplies no bounded task details; inferring a particular workflow would invent duties.
